hint.en: Fires once when a smart task ends. The [[outcome]] tag tells you how it ended. The values are succeeded (target reached and held), device_idle (the device stopped taking power while allowed to run), missed (ready-by time passed before reaching the target), and abandoned (cleared by hand or the device dropped out). Filter on these stable lowercase ids downstream. Check [[shortfall_known]] before comparing [[shortfall]], which is 0 when the gap to the target is unknown.
